newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZF talks with Labour, Nats postponed temporarily.
newsitem.headline: NZF talks with Labour, Nats postponed temporarily.

text.p: New Zealand First Party spokesman Mike Booker told journalists on Friday that head-to-head talks with the Labour and National parties had been temporarily postponed.
"Labour and National and New Zealand First have agreed for the moment to progress the talks by exchange of reports.
"When they consider enough progess has been made on these reports, the head to head talks will resume," Booker said.
He said the meeting postponed from Thursday with Labour was still a possibility.
"There is a possibility the talks will resume this afternoon," Booker said.
NZ First sources told Reuters the negotiators were working on about 30 different reports, covering 68 policy areas.
